answer: Mechanism: serialized escrow reputation (SER). Each agent gets one active transaction thread. New identities start with a 10× escrow multiplier per transaction; clean completions lower it toward a 1× haven. The multiplier decays only on the same thread, so cloning requires opening parallel threads, each prefunded at the full 10× escrow and held through dispute windows. Attacker cost: N× locked capital plus latency, and any fraud forfeits each clone’s escrow. Honest agents avoid this spiral by keeping one thread clean, making honesty cheaper than mass cloning.
